kind: diagnostic only, not a stability/performance benchmark
notes: Original diagnostic measured the engine before explicit garbage collection was integrated into close(). It showed Metal active allocations already returned to 8 bytes after close; an additional gc.collect reduced RSS by about 10 MiB. Repeating this script against final close() includes that GC earlier. Repeated model/tokenizer reloads can retain CPU/Rust allocator arenas; steady-state same-model cache stability is reported separately.
